description: Ingests Gusto payroll objects into Sergio's earnings read-model, as the earnings sync does: payrolls (Gusto get_payroll responses). Idempotent per (payroll, employee), so re-sending the same payroll writes nothing new. It writes Sergio's own store only; it sends nothing to Gusto. An audit row records the sync. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: sync_earnings
title: Sync Gusto payrolls into earnings
